# Data dictionary

<!-- Generated by scripts/generate_data_dictionary.py from the models. Don't edit by hand: change the model's description and regenerate. -->

Every table the pipeline writes, layer by layer, and the lookup tables that drive cleaning. For how the layers connect, see [architecture.md](architecture.md).

| Layer | Where | Written by |
|---|---|---|
| Raw | `data/raw/` | `coffee-review scrape` |
| Parsed | `data/parsed/` | `coffee-review parse` |
| Clean | `data/clean/` | `coffee-review clean` |
| Economic | `data/economic/` (responses in `data/raw/`) | `coffee-review fx`, `coffee-review cpi` |

## Raw layer: `data/raw/`

Saved pages are gzipped HTML at `reviews/<slug>.html.gz`. The manifest records what is known about each review.

### `manifest.sqlite`, table `reviews`

One row per review the sitemaps have listed. Written by `scrape`.

| Column | Type | Can be empty | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `slug` | text | no | The review's id: the last part of its URL. |
| `url` | text | no | The review page's address. |
| `lastmod` | datetime (UTC) | yes | When the sitemap last said the page changed (UTC), if it said. |
| `fetched_at` | datetime (UTC) | yes | The last successful fetch of the page (UTC); empty if never. |
| `last_attempt_at` | datetime (UTC) | no | The last fetch attempt of any outcome (UTC). |
| `status` | `ok` / `failed` / `gone` | no | How the last attempt went: ok, failed, or gone (the site says the page no longer exists). |
| `last_error` | text | yes | What went wrong on the last failed attempt. |
| `lookback_done` | true/false | no | Whether the page has had its one re-fetch a day after it appeared (reviews are often edited soon after publishing). |
| `first_seen_at` | datetime (UTC) | no | When this review first appeared in a sitemap (UTC). |
| `delisted_at` | datetime (UTC) | yes | When the review dropped out of the sitemaps (UTC); its saved copy is kept. |

### Economic-data responses: `data/raw/fx/`, `data/raw/cpi/`

Written by `fx` and `cpi`. The tidy economic tables are rebuilt from these on every run (ADR 0009).

| File | What it holds |
|---|---|
| `fx/openexchangerates/<YYYY-MM-DD>.json` | One exchange-rate response per day (UTC), exactly as received; a 'not_available' answer is kept too, so that day isn't asked again. |
| `cpi/bls/<series>/<YYYYMMDDTHHMMSSZ>_<start>-<end>.json` | One CPI response per request: when it was made (UTC) and the years it asked for. A month can appear in several; the newest wins. |

## Parsed layer: `data/parsed/`

Every value is text, exactly as the page had it (ADR 0007). Written by `parse`, read by `clean`.

### `roasted/reviews.parquet`

One row per roasted review, values as text.

| Column | Type | Can be empty | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `slug` | String | no | The review's id: the last part of its URL. |
| `url` | String | no | The review page's address. |
| `delisted` | Boolean | no | True when the review is no longer in the site's sitemaps. |
| `sold_green` | Boolean | no | True when the title says the coffee was sold green (1997–1999 reviews). |
| `title` | String | yes | The coffee's name as reviewed. |
| `roaster` | String | yes | The roaster (for green reviews, the importer or seller) as written. |
| `roaster_url` | String | yes | The link on the roaster's logo. |
| `rating` | String | yes | The overall score as written: 50–100, or NR (not rated). |
| `review_date` | String | yes | The review month as written: "Month YYYY". |
| `roaster_location` | String | yes | Where the roaster is, as written ("Toronto, Ontario, Canada"). |
| `coffee_origin` | String | yes | Where the coffee was grown, as written ("Guji Zone, Oromia Region, southern Ethiopia"). |
| `roast_level` | String | yes | Roast level as written (Light … Very Dark, or NA). |
| `agtron` | String | yes | Agtron roast-colour readings as written: whole bean / ground ("55/68"). |
| `price` | String | yes | The price as written ("NT $700/200 grams", "NA"). |
| `aroma` | String | yes | Aroma score as written (1–10). |
| `acidity` | String | yes | Acidity score as written (1–10; "Acidity/Structure" on newer pages). |
| `body` | String | yes | Body score as written (1–10). |
| `flavor` | String | yes | Flavor score as written (1–10). |
| `aftertaste` | String | yes | Aftertaste score as written (1–10). |
| `with_milk` | String | yes | Espresso only: the score in milk, as written (1–10). |
| `blind_assessment` | String | yes | The reviewers' tasting notes, written blind. |
| `notes` | String | yes | Background on the coffee, the farm and the roaster. |
| `bottom_line` | String | yes | The summary judgement ("Who Should Drink It" before 2016). |
| `extra_count` | Int32 | no | How many labels on the page went to extra_fields (unknown labels). |

### `green/reviews.parquet`

One row per green review, values as text.

| Column | Type | Can be empty | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `slug` | String | no | The review's id: the last part of its URL. |
| `url` | String | no | The review page's address. |
| `delisted` | Boolean | no | True when the review is no longer in the site's sitemaps. |
| `title` | String | yes | The coffee's name as reviewed. |
| `roaster` | String | yes | The roaster (for green reviews, the importer or seller) as written. |
| `roaster_url` | String | yes | The link on the roaster's logo. |
| `rating` | String | yes | The overall score as written: 50–100, or NR (not rated). |
| `review_date` | String | yes | The review month as written: "Month YYYY". |
| `coffee_origin` | String | yes | Where the coffee was grown, as written ("Guji Zone, Oromia Region, southern Ethiopia"). |
| `price` | String | yes | The price as written ("NT $700/200 grams", "NA"). |
| `harvested` | String | yes | When the green coffee was harvested, as written. |
| `seller` | String | yes | Who sells the green coffee. |
| `variety` | String | yes | The coffee variety (cultivar): "Gesha", "SL34". |
| `lot_size` | String | yes | How much of the lot is for sale, as written. |

| `blind_assessment` | String | yes | The reviewers' tasting notes, written blind. |
| `notes` | String | yes | Background on the coffee, the farm and the roaster. |

### `roasted/extra_fields.parquet`, `green/extra_fields.parquet`

Labels and headings the parser didn't recognise, kept as found.

| Column | Type | Can be empty | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `slug` | String | no | The review the label was found on. |
| `label` | String | no | The label or heading as written (headings are prefixed 'section: '). |
| `value` | String | no | Its value as written. |

### `parse_issues.parquet`

Pages worth a look. Never stops a run.

| Column | Type | Can be empty | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `slug` | text | no | The page's slug (as found, even if it isn't a valid one). |
| `kind` | `no_review_template` / `duplicate_label` / `missing_required` / `page_missing` / `parse_error` | no | What kind of problem: no_review_template, duplicate_label, missing_required, page_missing or parse_error. |
| `detail` | text | no | A short note saying what was found. |

## Clean layer: `data/clean/`

Typed columns, checked against the contract in `models/clean.py` on every run (ADR 0008). Written by `clean`.

### `roasted/reviews.parquet`

One row per roasted review (espresso included).

| Column | Type | Can be empty | Checks | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `slug` | String | no | unique | The review's id: the last part of its URL. Unique. |
| `url` | String | no | – | The review page's address. |
| `delisted` | Boolean | no | – | True when the review is no longer in the site's sitemaps. |
| `sold_green` | Boolean | no | – | True when the title says the coffee was sold green (1997–1999). |
| `title` | String | yes | – | The coffee's name as reviewed. |
| `roaster` | String | yes | – | The roaster (green reviews: the importer or seller). |
| `roaster_url` | String | yes | – | The link on the roaster's logo. |
| `review_month` | Date | yes | always the 1st | The month of the review, always stored as its 1st day (the site gives only month and year). |
| `rating` | Int16 | yes | ≥ 50, ≤ 100 | Overall score, 50–100. Empty when not rated (NR). |
| `roaster_city` | String | yes | – | The roaster's city, as written. |
| `roaster_region` | String | yes | – | The roaster's state or province, by its standard name. |
| `roaster_country` | String | yes | – | The roaster's country (Hawaiʻi roasters: United States). |
| `origin_country` | String | yes | – | Where the coffee was grown: one country (Hawaiʻi and Puerto Rico count as their own), "Multiple" for a blend, empty if not disclosed. |
| `origin_region` | String | yes | – | The growing region(s), comma-separated, without filler words; direction words kept ("Guji, Oromia", "North Sumatra"). |
| `roast_level` | Enum (6 roast levels) | yes | – | Roast level, ordered light to dark: Light, Medium-Light, Medium, Medium-Dark, Dark, Very Dark. |
| `agtron_whole` | Int16 | yes | > 0, ≤ 7000 | Agtron reading of the whole bean: higher is lighter. |
| `agtron_ground` | Int16 | yes | > 0, ≤ 7000 | Agtron reading of the ground coffee: higher is lighter. |
| `agtron_swapped` | Boolean | no | – | True when the readings were printed ground-first (June 2002 – March 2003) and swapped back. |
| `agtron_corrected` | Boolean | no | – | True when a typo with a known pattern was corrected (6489/89 → 64/89). |
| `agtron_suspect` | Boolean | no | – | True when a reading is kept as written but doubtful (a decimal, above 150, or not reversed in the swap window). |
| `price_amount` | Float64 | yes | > 0 | The price in its own currency (not converted). |
| `price_currency` | String | yes | matches `^[A-Z]{3}$` | ISO 4217 currency code (USD, TWD, CAD…). |
| `price_currency_inferred` | Boolean | no | – | True when the currency was read from the roaster's country ($ outside the US, ¥, E, pesos), not written plainly. |
| `price_quantity` | Float64 | yes | > 0 | How much the price buys, in price_unit. 1 when the page gives none. |
| `price_unit` | String | yes | – | The unit: ounce, gram, kilogram, pound, fluid ounce, millilitre, or a count (capsule, pod, bag…). |
| `price_grams` | Float64 | yes | > 0 | The quantity in grams, for weights only. |
| `price_note` | String | yes | – | Anything else in the price text: brackets, a second price, a packaging word. |
| `aroma` | Float32 | yes | ≥ 1, ≤ 10 | Aroma, 1–10 (decimals in 1997–1999). |
| `acidity` | Float32 | yes | ≥ 1, ≤ 10 | Acidity, 1–10 (decimals in 1997–1999). |
| `body` | Float32 | yes | ≥ 1, ≤ 10 | Body, 1–10 (decimals in 1997–1999). |
| `flavor` | Float32 | yes | ≥ 1, ≤ 10 | Flavor, 1–10 (decimals in 1997–1999). |
| `aftertaste` | Float32 | yes | ≥ 1, ≤ 10 | Aftertaste, 1–10. Missing on many older reviews. |
| `with_milk` | Float32 | yes | ≥ 1, ≤ 10 | Espresso only: the score in milk, 1–10. |
| `blind_assessment` | String | yes | – | The reviewers' tasting notes, written blind. |
| `notes` | String | yes | – | Background on the coffee, the farm and the roaster. |
| `bottom_line` | String | yes | – | The summary judgement. |
| `extra_count` | Int32 | no | – | How many unrecognised labels the parsed page had (see the parsed extra_fields table). |

### `cleaning_log.parquet`

One row for every rule applied to a value, with the original text.

| Column | Type | Can be empty | Checks | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `slug` | String | no | – | The review the rule was applied to. |
| `dataset` | String | no | one of `roasted`, `green` | roasted or green. |
| `field` | String | no | – | The parsed field the rule was applied to (rating, agtron, price…). |
| `rule` | String | no | one of the cleaning rules | The rule: one of the cleaning rules. |
| `raw_value` | String | yes | – | The field's parsed text, before cleaning. |

### Cleaning rules

The values of `cleaning_log.rule`: every change the clean stage makes.

| Rule | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `unknown_marker` | The site's own "unknown": NA, na, n/a, NR or blank. The value is empty. |
| `not_rated` | Rating NR: the coffee wasn't rated. |
| `word_score` | A score written as a word (acidity "Low"). The value is empty. |
| `labelled_score` | A score written with a label ("Flavor in milk: 5" → 5). |
| `not_measured` | Agtron 0: not measured. The reading is empty. |
| `template_label` | Agtron "g/wb": the template's label, printed where the numbers should be. |
| `swapped_2002_2003` | Agtron printed ground-first (June 2002 – March 2003), swapped back. |
| `typo_corrected` | Agtron typo with a known pattern, corrected (6489/89 → 64/89). |
| `unswapped_in_window` | In the Agtron swap window but not reversed: kept, flagged suspect. |
| `suspect_value` | Kept as written but doubtful, or out of range and left empty. |
| `not_disclosed` | "Not disclosed": the site doesn't say. The value is empty. |
| `unplaced` | No known place found. The value is empty; listed in the report to review. |
| `multiple_origins` | More than one country, or a blend: origin_country is "Multiple". |
| `close_spelling` | Matched by a close spelling of a known place or unit (Calfornia → California); listed in the report to review. |
| `not_a_price` | Not a price (NA, Not Available, See website…). The price is empty. |
| `no_quantity` | An amount with no quantity ("$15.00"). |
| `unparsed` | No known shape. The value is empty; the text is in the log and the report. |
| `unknown_currency` | A currency spelling not in the lookup tables. The currency is empty. |
| `ambiguous_currency` | A symbol whose currency the roaster's country can't settle (¥ outside Japan and China). |
| `currency_from_roaster` | A currency read from the roaster's country ($ outside the US, ¥, E, pesos). |
| `unknown_unit` | A unit not in the lookup tables (multipacks: "six 8-ounce cans"). Quantity and unit are empty. |
| `zero_width_removed` | Invisible zero-width characters removed from the text. |

## Economic layer: `data/economic/`

Exchange rates and US CPI for the enrich stage to convert and adjust prices with. Rebuilt in full from the saved responses and checked against the contracts in `models/economic.py` on every run. Written by `fx` and `cpi`. A period the source has no data for (October 2025's CPI) is simply absent.

### `fx.parquet`

One row per day (the 1st of each month) and currency.

Key: each (`day`, `currency`) appears once.

| Column | Type | Can be empty | Checks | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `day` | Date | no | always the 1st | The day the rate is for, in UTC: always the 1st of a month. |
| `currency` | String | no | matches `^[A-Z]{3}$` | ISO 4217 currency code. |
| `units_per_usd` | Float64 | no | > 0 | Units of the currency one US dollar bought that day. |

### `cpi.parquet`

One row per series and month.

Key: each (`month`, `series`) appears once.

| Column | Type | Can be empty | Checks | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `month` | Date | no | always the 1st | The month, stored as its 1st. |
| `series` | String | no | – | The series id (CUUR0000SA0: CPI-U, all items, US city average, not seasonally adjusted). |
| `index_value` | Float64 | no | > 0 | The index for the month (1982–84 = 100 for CUUR0000SA0). |

## Lookup tables: `src/coffee_review/transforms/lookups/`

Versioned with the code. A table gains a row when the clean report lists a real place, currency or unit it doesn't know.

### `countries.csv` (418 rows)

Every ISO 3166 country and its spellings. Generated by `scripts/generate_lookup_tables.py`; don't edit by hand.

| Column | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `alias` | A spelling. |
| `name` | The country it means, by common name. |

### `places.csv` (262 rows)

Hand-kept spellings the ISO list lacks: other country spellings, Hawaiʻi, islands, coffee regions, broad areas, US states and Canadian provinces.

| Column | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `alias` | A spelling, matched ignoring case, quotes and punctuation. |
| `name` | The place's standard name (used in region columns). |
| `country` | The coffee-origin country it's in ('Multiple' for an area). |
| `kind` | country, state, province, island, region or area. |
| `roaster_country` | The country for a roaster address, when it differs (Hawaiʻi → United States); blank otherwise. |

### `areas.csv` (212 rows)

Hand-kept: the countries in each broad area, so 'Guatemala, Central America' is Guatemala but 'Indonesia; South America' is a blend.

| Column | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `area` | A broad area's name. |
| `country` | A country inside it. |

### `currency_codes.csv` (178 rows)

Every ISO 4217 currency code. Generated by `scripts/generate_lookup_tables.py`.

| Column | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `code` | A currency code; each means itself. |

### `currencies.csv` (16 rows)

Hand-kept: other ways prices write a currency (`NT`, `£`, `Kč`).

| Column | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `alias` | A spelling as written. |
| `currency` | Its ISO 4217 code. |

### `roaster_currencies.csv` (36 rows)

Hand-kept: symbols whose currency depends on the roaster's country (`$`, `¥`, `E`, `pesos`).

| Column | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `symbol` | The symbol as written. |
| `roaster_country` | The roaster's country, or `*` for anywhere else. |
| `currency` | The ISO 4217 code it means there. |

### `units.csv` (69 rows)

Hand-kept: every way prices write a unit.

| Column | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `alias` | A spelling as written. |
| `name` | The standard unit (ounce, gram, fluid ounce, capsule…). |
| `kind` | weight, volume or count. |
| `grams` | Grams per unit, for weights; blank otherwise. |
